text:
sophie: :rotating_light: LumenWell (dedicated) opened a P1 — customers seeing intermittent 503s + p99 tail on embeddings since 08:05. CS pinged at 08:12. Can engineering owners confirm immediate mitigation plan and who owns follow-up?

raj: seeing increased queue depth on pool-dedicated-3, lots of KV cache miss churn. Might be autoscaler thrash after patch.

olivia: on it — checking autoscaler logs now. If autoscaler is oscillating we can cap scale down frequency as a short-term.

diego: model side: we rolled a new quantized embedder yesterday for performance. If that introduced memory pressure it could explain 503s. Suggest fallback to previous variant for LumenWell routing.

maya: @olivia can you confirm whether we hit GPU OOMs or api-server 429/502 from infra? Logs are noisy.

olivia: no OOMs in node logs, but controller reports repeated pod restarts (liveness) on pool-dedicated-3 around 08:03-08:10. Investigating liveness probe sensitivity.

sophie: Customer needs ETA for workaround (short timeframe). They're blocking a morning demo.

raj: short-term mitigation options: 1) route LumenWell to fallback embedder v1 (no quant) 2) increase pool capacity by +1 GPU (burst) 3) tweak liveness probe to avoid restarts while we triage. Which can we do fastest?

diego: option 1 is fastest from model side — a config toggle in routing table. I can flip it if infra gives green.

olivia: option 2 needs infra approval for capacity bump, but we can request burst now. ETA ~20-30m if approved.

noah: product OKs fallback for customer demo. Prefer fallback to v1 to avoid infra churn. Confirmed with account team.

maya: I'll take probe tweak if needed (low risk) — but prefer not to mask root cause.

raj: ok action plan: 
- diego -> flip routing for LumenWell to embedder-v1 (rollback quant) now (owner)
- olivia -> request +1 GPU burst as contingency (owner)
- maya -> prepare liveness probe rollback patch in case restarts persist (owner)
- raj -> monitor p99/p95 and queue depth, coordinate with CS

diego: flipping routing now. command: ```curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/route/switch -d '{"customer":"lumenwell","model":"embedder-v1"}'``` will push immediately. I’ll post when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by diego at 08:25:13 (deploy-id: dep-77821)

diego: done — routing switch succeeded, returning 200.

raj: seeing immediate drop in queue depth and fewer 503s in the logs. Nice.

sophie: LumenWell confirms demo can proceed, they see improved stability. Thank you. :pray:

olivia: burst request submitted to infra team (ticket INF-5432). If autoscaler still oscillates we will apply cooldown.

maya: keeping liveness probe change ready: small PR in my queue (link: https://git.internal/redwood/probe-fix). Will only roll if restarts continue > 5m.

noah: longer-term action items we should track:
- diego: run a regression/eval of quantized embedder under LumenWell load profile (owner: diego)
- eng-sre/olivia: analyze autoscaler thresholds and add a safer cooldown default for dedicated pools (owner: olivia)
- raj: improve alerting to include queue depth + deploy correlations (owner: raj)

sophie: I'll file the customer follow-up note and share the demo outcome.

diego: posting quick postmortem draft in #postmortems after initial data, will link here.

raj: thanks everyone. If anything regresses, ping @here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
